read.title: Feedback on Your Draft
read.text:
Hi Chloe,

Thank you for sending the draft so quickly. Overall, the video looks great, and we love the morning routine idea.

Before you post, could you make two small changes? First, please say that the serum is for dry skin, not all skin types. Second, please add an ad disclosure at the beginning of the caption.

Once these are done, we will approve the video right away. The planned posting date is still December 3.

Best,
Minsu
